references.text: Moses predicts a star from Jacob, which is interpreted as a prophecy about the Messiah.
Balaam's prophecy of a star rising from Jacob, often understood as a prediction of Christ.
Nations shall come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn, which can be linked to the wise men who followed the star.
The wise men ask where the king of the Jews is born, for they have seen his star in the East and have come to worship him.
God's tender mercy, by which the sunrise from on high will visit us, can be seen as a metaphorical reference to Christ as the light of the world.
Jesus refers to himself as the bright morning star, which can be seen as a connection to the star in Matthew.
